headline: Claude and Codex, in one relay
pill: Claude proposes, Codex reviews, Claude replies
summary: The first version: give Turnhuddle a task and it runs Claude Code, then Codex, then Claude again through their command-line tools, sharing one conversation ID and the full history. The exchange appears in the Turnhuddle Output channel.
improvements: **Turnhuddle: Check CLI Installations** confirms both CLIs are found before you start.
Cancel a conversation from the progress notification; the running CLI is stopped and later turns don't start.
Per-turn timeouts and an output limit keep a stuck CLI from hanging VS Code.
Errors include the last lines the CLI printed, so a sign-in problem is obvious.
